newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks close mixed, Zagrebacka rises.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks close mixed, Zagrebacka rises.

text.p: Croatian stocks closed mixed to higher on Thursday, with Zagrebacka Banka forging ahead on the back of the strong dollar.
* Eight of 16 active issues rose, four fell and four were flat.
* Volume halved to 14,676 units, turnover down to 13.9 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer Zagrebacka Banka added 99.88 kuna or 4.5 percent to 2,305.12. Zagrebacka was also the most active issue with 4,254 shares sold.
* Biggest decliner Dalmatinska Banka lost 27 kuna or 8.2 percent to 303 on volume of 300 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom +385 1 455 7075
